blocks.text: A home does not always need a major makeover to feel different. Sometimes, a better lighting setup, a few organizers, or a simple rearrangement of furniture can make everyday living more comfortable. Bringing these practical home ideas closer to Cebuano families, IKEA Philippines rolls its Home Furnishing Bus into Cebu from November 6 to 8, 2026. The mobile showroom offers a curated preview of the Swedish home furnishing brand’s products ahead of the upcoming IKEA Cebu store in Mandaue, which is expected to carry approximately 2,500 articles available for in-store purchase.
